desc: Develop and validate an exact NTT-based counting algorithm, including the ordered-endpoint and degenerate-pair correction.
Assess pure-Python NTT runtime and memory feasibility at transform length \(2^{21}\); optimize representation and loops as needed.
Verify coefficient indexing, transform size, shift conventions, and boundary handling for values 1 through \(10^6\).
Establish time and memory complexity and ensure it is safe for the maximum constraints.
Produce the final stdin/stdout Python implementation with the requested code delimiters.
